{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm the final dataset has 800 unique patients
assert len(trial_df) == 800, "Expected 800 unique patients after deduplication"

# Check that 'arm' and 'severity' are the only grouping variables of interest
# and that arm assignment is confounded by severity
print(trial_df[['arm', 'severity']].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
